changelog: Fix Stuck Agent Environment on Account Switch: Extended Go supervisor CSRF probe timeout to 6s with automated retries, eliminating context deadline exceeded timeouts on mobile devices
Continuous Supervisor Lifecycle: Preserved background hub state monitor across hub restarts so CSRF tokens are continuously acquired and broadcast to the app
Strict Single-Active Account Display: Enforced single-source active account resolution so only the current active profile is marked Active in the switcher UI
Dual Token Synchronization: Synchronized oauth credentials across both antigravity-oauth-token and jetski-standalone-oauth-token, matching official AGY CLI multi-profile specs
Persistent Active Account: Persisted chosen active account ID in SharedPreferences across app restarts
